title: Host fields, auxiliary primes and windows of scales
summary: For a primitive character $\psi$ and a scale $x$ the argument works in an abelian CM field $E$: the compositum of the real subfield of $\mathbf Q(\zeta_{2^{e+2}})$ with $2^{e}\asymp x^{2+8\varepsilon}$, the field cut out by $\psi$, and $\mathbf Q(\sqrt{-q},\sqrt{-d})$ for auxiliary primes with $\log q\approx Y^{\varepsilon/5}$. The chapter chooses the primes $q,d$ so that every twist of a character of bounded conductor by $(\cdot/q)$ or $(\cdot/d)$ satisfies a square-root bound for its Chebyshev sum on $[Y,Y^{A}]$; this rests on a zero-density estimate and a mean-square bound over quadratic twists. Behrend's construction gives the thick places of the host, a large set of Galois elements that every Frobenius orbit meets at most twice in each stretch of length about $\log x$; it is not used to choose the $2$-power tower. The chapter then assembles hosts that satisfy all host conditions at every scale of a set with windows of exponent $3/2$.
progress: Completion pass: frame renamed Galois datum, the orbit condition of the good host defined (hf-good-orbit), and the proofs of fieldChi, meanSqK, box_of_S, levelData, thinH, topsChoiceH and the Behrend corollary written step by step; 46 statements, no OPEN items.

statements.statement: Let $0<\varepsilon$ and $Y>1$, and put $L=Y^{\varepsilon/5}$. A pair of primes $(q,d)$ is admissible at $Y$ if $q\equiv3\pmod8$, $d\equiv7\pmod{16}$, $L/2<\log q\le L$, $\tfrac12L\log^2Y<\log d\le L\log^2Y$, $q\mid d+1$, and every odd prime $p\le L$ divides $d+1$.
statements.label: hf-admissible-pair

statements.statement: Let $\psi$ be a primitive Dirichlet character of conductor $N_\psi$, let $e\ge0$, and let $q,d$ be odd primes. A number field $E$ is the host field of $(\psi,e,q,d)$ if for some $N$ divisible by $2^{e+2}$, $N_\psi$, $q$ and $d$ it is isomorphic to the subfield of $\mathbf Q(\zeta_N)$ fixed by the automorphisms $\zeta_N\mapsto\zeta_N^{a}$ with $a\equiv\pm1\pmod{2^{e+2}}$, $\psi(a)=1$ and $(a/q)=(a/d)=1$. Thus $E$ is the compositum of $\mathbf Q(\zeta_{2^{e+2}})^{+}$, the field cut out by $\psi$, and $\mathbf Q(\sqrt{-q},\sqrt{-d})$ when $q\equiv d\equiv3\pmod 4$; it is a CM field.
statements.label: hf-host-field-of-character

statements.statement: Let $(x,\varepsilon,J)$ be a scale and $\delta_1=x^{-\varepsilon/8}$. A rank datum with $n,k,m,t$ is adapted to the scale if $x^{2+8\varepsilon}\le n\le2x^{2+8\varepsilon}$, $\sqrt{x\delta_1}\le m\le2\sqrt{x\delta_1}$, $x^{9/2+10\varepsilon}\le k\le2x^{9/2+10\varepsilon}$, and $r+t=8fr+4+\lceil x^{377}\rceil w$ with $f=2n$, $r=k+m-1$ and $w=8\lceil10r(f+f^2(k-1)^3x^{2\varepsilon}/m)/8\rceil$.
statements.label: hf-adapted-ranks

statements.reference: Gallagher, Invent. Math. 11 (1970); Montgomery, LNM 227 (1971), Chapter 12; Davenport, Multiplicative Number Theory, Chapters 13 and 14. Used in Chapter 13 (through LitThin), not in the choice of auxiliary primes.
statements.statement: There are constants $C_1,c>0$ with the following properties. (a) For $Q\ge3$, the zeros $\rho$ of $L(s,\chi)$, for primitive $\chi$ of conductor at most $Q$, with $\operatorname{Re}\rho\ge1-1/400$ and $|\operatorname{Im}\rho|\le Q$, number at most $C_1Q^{1/4}$ counted with multiplicity. (b) Let $\chi$ be primitive of conductor $N\ge3$. If $L(\rho,\chi)=0$ with $\operatorname{Re}\rho\ge1-c/\log\max(N,N|\operatorname{Im}\rho|)$, then $\chi$ is real, $\rho$ is real and simple, and $\rho$ is the only zero of $L(s,\chi)$ in that region. (c) Every zero $\rho$ of $\zeta$ with $0<\operatorname{Re}\rho<1$ has $\operatorname{Re}\rho\le1-c/\log(|\operatorname{Im}\rho|+3)$.
statements.label: hf-zero-density-regions

statements.statement: Primes in progressions: (a) the prime number theorem modulo $M$ ($8\mid M$) with the exceptional zero term, with relative error $A_0(e^{-c_3\log X/\log M}+e^{-\sqrt{c_3\log X}})$ for $\log X\ge C_0\log M\log(\log M+2)$; (b) two real characters of moduli at most $Z$ with real zeros in $(1-c_0/\log Z,1)$ agree; (c) a real zero of a real nontrivial character modulo $M$ is at most $1-c_1/M$.
statements.reference: Gallagher, Invent. Math. 11 (1970); Davenport, Multiplicative Number Theory, Chapters 14 and 20. Also page_across and excBound.
statements.label: hf-primes-progressions

statements.statement: For primes $q$ in $(\sqrt U,U]$ in a progression modulo $m_0$, $8\mid m_0$, with $\log U$ between $Y^{\varepsilon/6}$ and $Y^{\varepsilon/5}\log^2Y$ and at least $\frac14\log^2Y\log m_0$: there is $s^*$ such that $|\sum_q(\frac qs)|\le Y^{-B}|P|$ for every odd squarefree $1<s\le Y^A$ prime to $m_0$ other than $s^*$.
statements.label: hf-twisted-prime-sums

statements.statement: Estimates for sums of $c_y(n)=\Lambda(n)\min(1,y/n)$ over powers of a prime ($\le3\log y$), their squares summed over primes ($\ll y\log y$), over prime powers with even exponent or prime dividing $m_0$ ($\ll\sqrt y+w\log y$), and over $n\le Z$ ($\ll y\log Z$).
statements.label: hf-prime-power-sums

statements.statement: Let $M\ge1$, $0<\varepsilon<1/52$ and $A\ge1$. There is $Y_1$ such that for every $Y\ge Y_1$ there are primes $q,d$, admissible at $Y$ and prime to $M$, with the following properties. For every Dirichlet character $\xi$ modulo $M$ and every $(i,j)\in\{0,1\}^2$ other than $(0,0)$, the primitive character $\chi$ inducing $\xi\,(\cdot/q)^{i}(\cdot/d)^{j}$ satisfies $|g_\chi(y)|\le y^{1/2+\varepsilon/2}$ and $|\tfrac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)|\le4\log y$ for all $y\in[Y,Y^{A}]$. For every real primitive character $\rho$ of conductor dividing $8M$ and every such $(i,j)$, the primitive character inducing $\rho\,(\cdot/q)^{i}(\cdot/d)^{j}$ has no zeros with $\operatorname{Re}s>1-1/400$ and $|\operatorname{Im}s|\le 8M\exp(Y^{\varepsilon/5})\exp(Y^{\varepsilon/5}\log^2Y)^{j}$. Here $g_\chi(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(y/n-1)+y\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)$.
statements.label: hf-good-pairs-exist

statements.reference: Behrend, Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 32 (1946); the construction is the sphere construction in Mathlib
statements.statement: There is $C>0$ such that for all integers $n\ge0$ and $L\ge2$ there is a finite set $T$ of non-negative integers with $4Ls<n$ for $s\in T$, with $|T|\ge n\,e^{-C\sqrt{\log n\log L}}/L$, and with no relations $j(s_2-s_1)=i(s_3-s_1)$ for pairwise distinct $s_1,s_2,s_3\in T$ and integers $i\ne j$ with $0<|i|,|j|\le L$. Behrend's construction gives it with $C=32$; the set is used for the thick places of a host, whose Frobenius orbits it meets at most twice per window of length $L$.
statements.label: hf-behrend-set

statements.statement: Let $K$ be a level with integer $o_K$ and exceptional character $\psi_K$ if any (Chapter 2). Let $\Phi$ be a Galois datum with Galois group $\{\pm1\}^2\times A$, index $o$ and cyclic subgroup $A_0$, let $E$ be a host field on $\Phi$, let $T\subset A$ be finite and $x,\varepsilon,C$ real. The host conditions for $K$ at $(x,\varepsilon,C)$ with top classes $T$ require: $o=o_K$; every $\chi\in K$ is $\chi_\theta$ for some $\theta\in X^+$; if $\psi_K$ exists it is the primitive character $\chi_{-q}$ of the first sign, and otherwise $\chi_{-q}\notin K$ (not empty for cyclic levels); for every $\gamma\in A$, $|\#\{t\in T:t-\gamma\in A_0\}-\lambda_\gamma|T||\le x^{-1+\varepsilon}|T|$ with $\lambda_\gamma=4/(3o+1)$ on $A_0$ and $3/(3o+1)$ off it; and every $\theta\in X^-$, and every $\theta\in X^+$ with $\chi_\theta\notin K$, has $|g_{\chi_\theta}(x)|\le x^{1/2+\varepsilon}$ and $|\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi_\theta)|\le C\log x$.
statements.label: hf-host-conditions

statements.statement: Let $0<\varepsilon<1/52$ and $C_0\ge1$. There are constants $C_8\ge C_0$, $c_6,C_b>0$ and $x_0$ such that the following holds for every scale $x\ge x_0$ with ranks adapted to $(x,\varepsilon)$. Let $E_0$ be a candidate host field whose auxiliary primes $(q,d)$ are admissible at some $Y$ in the allowed range and satisfy the conclusion of the existence of good prime pairs with modulus $M\le C_0$ on $[Y,x]$, and whose remaining invariants are bounded by $C_0$. Then $E_0$ extends to a host with an auxiliary prime $q_0\equiv1\pmod{Q_Sqd}$, $q_0\le(Q_Sqd)^{C_8}$, that satisfies all host conditions (Chebyshev bounds for all host characters at scales $y\ge e^{x^{\varepsilon/3}}/3$, absence of real zeros with $\operatorname{Re}s>1-1/400$ in boxes, norm primes $g_i=\pi\bar\pi$ with $\pi\equiv1$), and a set $T$ of Frobenius classes with the distribution property of the host conditions at $x$.
statements.label: hf-good-host-exists

statements.statement: Let $\psi$ be a primitive Dirichlet character that satisfies the weakening of Vandiver's conjecture with exponent $401$ (Chapter 10). Then for every $0<\varepsilon<1/52$ there are constants and a set of scales with windows of exponent $3/2$ such that for every large scale $x$ in it there are a rank datum adapted to $(x,\varepsilon)$, a host $H$ good at the scale, and an auxiliary prime $q_0$, such that the host field $E$ satisfies the host conditions of the cyclic level of $\psi$ at $(x,\varepsilon,4)$ and the Tate-Shafarevich bound $(t,e^{x^{\varepsilon}/2})$, $t$ the twist parameter of the rank datum.
statements.label: hf-hosts-on-windows
hf-frame
statements.statement: A Galois datum with $2$-power exponent $e$: a finite abelian group $A$ of order $n$ with its elements numbered $0,\ldots,n-1$, a surjection $h:A\to(\mathbf Z/2^{e+2})^\times/\{\pm1\}$ and $a_0\in A$ with $h$ injective on $A_0=\langle a_0\rangle$; its Galois group is $\{\pm1\}^2\times A$, with characters $X^\pm$ trivial on $\tau_1(A_0)$ and $\pm1$ at $\iota_d$.

statements.label: hf-framed-host-field
statements.statement: A host field on a Galois datum: primes $q\equiv3\ (8)$, $d\equiv7\ (16)$ with $(\frac{-d}{q})=1$, a modulus $Q_S$ divisible by $2^{e+2}$, a Galois field $E\subset\mathbf Q(\zeta_{Q_Sqd})$ with Galois group identified with that of the frame, and an Artin map from $(\mathbf Z/Q_Sqd)^\times$ compatible with the cyclotomic one, with prescribed behaviour of $-1$, of the $2$-power tower and of the inertia at $q$ and $d$.

statements.label: hf-host-field-properties
statements.statement: A host field on a Galois datum is CM of degree $4n$, its Artin map is surjective and gives the Frobenius elements, the inertia at $d$ is $\{1,\iota_d\}$, $E/F$ is unramified at all finite primes, and $\mathfrak D_{E/K}=\mathfrak b\bar{\mathfrak b}$ with $\mathfrak b+\bar{\mathfrak b}=1$.

statements.label: hf-kernel-host-field
statements.statement: If the Artin map of a host field has the kernel cut out by $\pm1$ modulo $2^{e+2}$, $\psi$ and the two Legendre symbols, then $E$ is a host field of $(\psi,e,q,d)$.

statements.label: hf-host-field-rows
statements.statement: A host field has splitting bound $B$ if the first sign is $(\frac{\cdot}{q})$ with $\sqrt{-q}\in E$, $E\not\subset\mathbf Q(\zeta_{N/\ell})$ for $\ell\mid Q_S$, $Q_S\le n^2$, $o^{64}\le2^e$, $q\ne3$, $(\frac{-d}{p})=1$ for odd $p\le B$ and $4\ell\le B$ for odd $\ell\mid Q_S$.

statements.label: hf-host-field-exists
statements.statement: For a primitive $\psi$ there are $c\ge1$, $e_0$ such that for $e\ge e_0$ and admissible $q,d$ there is a Galois datum with $n=c2^e$ and index the order of $\psi$ and a host field on it with splitting bound $B$, $Q_S\mid\operatorname{lcm}(2^{e+2},N_\psi)$, the kernel of $\psi$, the powers of $\psi$ in $X^+$, and every character trivial on $\tau_1(A_0)$ of the form $\xi(\frac{\cdot}{q})^i(\frac{\cdot}{d})^j$ with $\xi\in\langle\psi\rangle$.

statements.label: hf-good-pair
statements.statement: A pair $(q,d)$ is good for $(M,\varepsilon,Y,X)$ if it is admissible at $Y$, prime to $M$, every twist $\xi(\frac{\cdot}{q})^i(\frac{\cdot}{d})^j$, $(i,j)\ne(0,0)$, $\xi$ mod $M$, has $|g_\chi(y)|\le y^{1/2+\varepsilon/2}$ and $|\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)|\le4\log y$ on $[Y,X]$, and the real such twists have no zeros with $\operatorname{Re}s>1-1/400$ up to height $8Me^{Y^{\varepsilon/5}}e^{jY^{\varepsilon/5}\log^2Y}$.

statements.label: hf-zero-density-box
statements.statement: At most $CQ^{1/4}$ primitive characters of conductor at most $Q$ have a zero with $\operatorname{Re}s>1-1/400$ and $|\operatorname{Im}s|\le Q$. This is the zero-density input of the choice of auxiliary primes.
statements.reference: Gallagher, Invent. Math. 11 (1970); Montgomery, LNM 227 (1971), Chapter 12 (weaker: counts characters, not zeros)

statements.label: hf-mean-square
statements.statement: Mean square over primes $q$ in a progression of the truncated twisted sums $S=\sum_{n\le Y^{400K}}\Lambda(n)\min(1,y/n)\kappa(n)(\frac nq)$: $\sum_q|S|^2\le Cy\log y\cdot\#\{q\}$ for $y\in[Y,Y^K]$.

If $L(s,\chi)$, $\chi\ne1$ of modulus $N\le Q$, has no zeros with $\operatorname{Re}s>1-1/400$, $|\operatorname{Im}s|\le Q$, then $|\frac{L'}{L}(s,\chi)|\le K_\delta\log Q$ for $\operatorname{Re}s\ge1-1/400+\delta$, $|\operatorname{Im}s|\le Q-1$.
statements.label: hf-log-derivative-box

statements.statement: Under a zero-free box of height $Q$: $|\Sigma_\chi(z+z\eta)-\Sigma_\chi(z)+z\eta\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)|\le A_\delta\log Q(\eta z^{1-1/400+\delta}\log Q+z^2/Q)$, with $\Sigma_\chi(y)=\sum_{n\le y}\Lambda(n)\chi(n)(y/n-1)$; by a contour shift in Perron's formula.
statements.label: hf-box-tail
hf-chebyshev-from-twisted-sum
statements.statement: If $\chi=\kappa(\frac{\cdot}{q})$ has a zero-free box near $1$ of height $Q$ and the truncated twisted sum is at most $y^{1/2+\tau}/2$ on $[Y,Y^K]$, then $|g_\chi(y)|\le y^{1/2+\tau}$ there and $|\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)|\le C\log Y$.

statements.label: hf-most-primes-good
statements.statement: All but a proportion $\eta$ of the primes $q\equiv3\ (8)$ in $(e^{z/2},e^z]$, and then of the primes $d$ in the progression of admissible $d$, give twists that are good (zero-free box, Chebyshev bound, $L'/L$ bound).

statements.label: hf-bounded-characters
statements.statement: In a host field built from $\psi$ with a good pair, every character in $X^-$ and every character in $X^+$ not inducing a power of $\psi$ satisfies $|g_\chi(x)|\le x^{1/2+\varepsilon}$ and $|\frac{L'}{L}(1,\chi)|\le4\log x$.

Good sets of positions in $\{0,\ldots,n'-1\}$ for $(x,\varepsilon,L_2)$: at most $K_\varepsilon$ in every window of length $L_2$, a marked tile among every $M_0+1$ consecutive tiles, at most $N_1$ in every window of length $G'$; an orbit $t+\langle y\rangle$ is good for $T$ if the positions of $T$ from its base point (the element of least number) form a good set.
statements.label: hf-good-orbit
hf-windows
statements.statement: Scales $(x,\varepsilon,J)$ with $x>1$, $0<\varepsilon<1/52$, $J\ge1$, and sets of scales $(J_W,W)$ with $W$ having windows of exponent $\lambda$.

statements.label: hf-windows-exist
statements.statement: If $\psi$ satisfies the weakening of Vandiver's conjecture with exponent $401$, there is $J$ such that every $x$ in windows $[Z,Z^{3/2}]$, $Z$ arbitrarily large, has $Y\in[x^{1/J},x]$, a good pair for $(N_\psi,\varepsilon,Y,x)$ and $e$ with $c2^e\asymp x^{2+8\varepsilon}$, such that all host fields of $(\psi,e,q,d)$ satisfy the Tate-Shafarevich bound $(\lfloor x^{400}\rfloor,e^{x^\varepsilon/2})$.

statements.label: hf-no-short-relations
statements.statement: A finite set $T$ of non-negative integers has no relations of length $L$ if $j(s_2-s_1)\ne i(s_3-s_1)$ for pairwise distinct $s_k\in T$ and integers $i\ne j$ with $0<|i|,|j|\le L$.

statements.label: hf-behrend-set-at-scale
statements.statement: At a scale $x$, for a Galois datum with $n\asymp x^{2+8\varepsilon}$ and $2\le L\ll\log x$, there is a Behrend set $T$ with $4Ls<n_0$, $4L|T|\le n_0$, $|T|\ge x^{-\varepsilon}n$ and $|T|\ge n_0e^{-C_T\sqrt{\log n_0\log L}}/L$.

statements.label: hf-thick-orbits
statements.statement: For a Behrend set $T$ with $4Ls<n_0$ and $T^\sharp=\{sa_0+u_0\}$, an arithmetic progression $t+iy$ in $A$ meets $T^\sharp$ at most twice in any $L$ consecutive steps if $y$ has order $>4L$, and at most once in total otherwise.

statements.label: hf-adapted-ranks-exist
statements.statement: For $x$ large every Galois datum with $x^{2+8\varepsilon}\le n\le2x^{2+8\varepsilon}$ underlies a rank datum adapted to the scale, and adapted rank data have $t\le x^{400}$.

statements.label: hf-host
statements.statement: A host for a rank datum: a host field on its Galois datum with splitting bound, $q,d>4tr+1$, a CM-type embedding, a square root $\mathfrak b$ of the relative different, level primes $g_0,g_1,p,p'$, an ideal $\mathfrak c$ of $\mathcal O_K$, top classes $T_{\mathrm{top}}\subset A$, a Behrend set $T_2$ with $u_0$, $L_w$, and a constant $C_T$; its thick places are $\tau_2(sa_0+u_0)$, $s\in T_2$.

statements.label: hf-host-extension
statements.statement: A host field with splitting bound $B$ and $q,d>4tr+1$ extends to a host with any admissible choice of level primes, $\mathfrak c$, top classes and Behrend set.

statements.label: hf-good-host
statements.statement: A host is good at a scale with constants $(C_8,C_5,c_6,C_b)$ and auxiliary prime $q_0$: sizes of $q,d$, of the top classes and of the Behrend set; norm primes $g_i=\pi\bar\pi$, $\pi\equiv1$, of size $(kb)^8$ with disjoint exceptional sets; small level primes $\equiv1$ modulo the conductor; Chebyshev and $L'/L$ bounds for $\chi_{-q},\chi_{-d},\chi_{-q}\chi_{-d}$; zero-free boxes for the real characters; a Chebyshev bound for all characters at $y\ge e^{x^{\varepsilon/3}}/3$; and few top classes with bad Frobenius orbits.
For a primitive $\chi$ of conductor $N\le e^\lambda$ without a real zero in $(1-c_1,1)$: $|\psi(u,\chi)-\delta_\chi u|\le Cu(\log u+\lambda)^2\exp(-c\log u/(\lambda+\sqrt{\log u}))$.
statements.reference: Davenport, Multiplicative Number Theory, Chapters 14, 19 and 20.
statements.label: hf-pnt-character

statements.statement: For primitive $\chi$ and $y\ge1$: $g_\chi(y)=-y\int_y^\infty(\psi(u,\chi)-\delta_\chi u)u^{-2}\,du$.
statements.label: hf-chebyshev-integral

statements.statement: At least $c'hX/((4dM^2)^A\log X)$ primes $g\in(X,X(1+h)]$ are norms $\pi\bar\pi$ with $\pi\equiv1\pmod M$ from $\mathbf Q(\sqrt{-d})$, when $\log(4dM^2)\le c\sqrt{\log X}$ and $e^{-c\sqrt{\log X}}\le h\le1$.
statements.reference: Lagarias-Odlyzko (1977); Stark, Invent. Math. 23 (1974). A consequence of the prime ideal theorem for Hecke L-functions of Q(sqrt(-d)).
statements.label: hf-norm-primes-short

statements.statement: For $g_1\in[Y,2Y]$ at most $(3r+1)(1+2r^2(Y^{3/4}+1))$ integers $g\in[Y,2Y]$ have $\mathcal B_r(g)\cap\mathcal B_r(g_1)\ne\emptyset$.
statements.label: hf-exceptional-primes
hf-norm-primes
statements.statement: Choice of the level primes: norm primes $g_0\ne g_1$ from $\mathbf Q(\sqrt{-d})$ with $\pi\equiv1\ (N)$ of size $(kb)^8$ with disjoint exceptional sets, and primes $p,p'\equiv1\ (15N)$, $q_0\equiv1\ (N)$ at most $N^{C_1}$; from primes represented by norms in short intervals and a Linnik-type bound.

statements.label: hf-host-chebyshev
statements.statement: If $\log N\le2x^{\varepsilon/5}\log^2x$ and the real characters of the host involving $q$ or $d$ have no real zeros in $(1-1/400,1)$, then every character of the host field has $|g_\chi(y)|\le ye^{-cx^{\varepsilon/8}}$ for $y\ge e^{x^{\varepsilon/3}}/3$.

For a random set of positions with independent probabilities in $[3\delta_1/4,\delta_1]$ along an orbit of length $n'\in[x^{\varepsilon/4},C_ox^{2+8\varepsilon}]$, the probability that the positions together with a given one are not good is at most $C_bx^{-2}$.
statements.label: hf-orbit-failure

statements.statement: Selection lemma: a random subset with independent probabilities at most $\delta$ has a value whose class counts are within $D$ of their means ($2\delta|\mathcal A|\le D^2$) and whose weighted count of bad elements is at most four times its mean bound.
statements.label: hf-random-selection
hf-top-classes
statements.statement: Top classes $T\subset A$ of size about $\delta_1n$, distributed over the cosets of $A_0$ with weights $4:3:\cdots:3$ up to $x^{-1+\varepsilon}$, and with few bad Frobenius orbits at inert primes, exist; by a random choice.

statements.label: hf-hosts-on-windows-def
statements.statement: Hosts satisfying a requirement $P$ exist on windows of exponent $\lambda$ if for every $\varepsilon$ there are constants and a set of scales with windows of exponent $\lambda$ at whose large scales there are an adapted rank datum, a good host and $q_0$ satisfying $P$.
